name: Jester’s Cap
body:
Price 18,500 gp; Slot head; CL 8th; Weight –; Aura faint abjuration, moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This is the typical three-pointed, multicolored hat with bells on, worn by court fools. The cap grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Bluff skill checks. In addition, the cap’s bells automatically ring if a hostile creature comes nearby, as per the alarm spell. The wearer can silence the bells at will.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 9,250 GP; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells alarm, glibness
